description: Create or add to a saved tracking list the user can monitor over time. list_type is one of asin, brand, seller, niche; name is the user's label for the list; items are the identifiers to track (ASINs, brand names, seller names, or niche keys). Captures a baseline of the current observed state so a later 'what changed' check can show new sellers and score moves. Use when the user says 'track these ASINs', 'add Nike to my brand watchlist', 'start monitoring ...'.
name: watchlist_add
